description: NaY(MoO₄)₂ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.50 Å) and four longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.40 Å) and four longer (2.43 Å) Y-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.81 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.81 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Mo atom.
